notes: 回形针起源有三种说法：一是挪威说，认为瓦勒（Johan Vaaler）发明，实为公众误传——他的美国专利 US 675,761（1901）设计从未投产；二是英国 1870 年代说，被 Early Office Museum 反驳；三是美国说，1892 年纽约 Cushman & Denison 推出 Gem 型，本条目采用此说。Gem 型从未申请专利，故 patent 为空。更早的费伊（Fay）美国专利 US 64,088（1867-04-23 授权）也是一种纸夹，标为 contested。
summary_zh: Gem 型回形针由纽约 Cushman & Denison 于 1892 年推出，从未申请专利；挪威瓦勒发明说是常见误传。
summary_en: The Gem-type clip was introduced by Cushman & Denison in New York in 1892 and was never patented. The Norwegian Vaaler origin story is a popular myth.
notes_en: Three origin claims circulate. The Norwegian story credits Johan Vaaler, but his US 675,761 (1901) design was never manufactured — a popular misconception. A British 1870s claim is disputed by the Early Office Museum. This entry follows the US account: Cushman & Denison’s Gem clip in New York, 1892. The Gem was never patented, so patent is null. Fay’s earlier US 64,088 (1867, Franklin, PA) is marked contested.
